purpose: TASK-D03 live managed Vertex AI EvalTask gate evidence: two full real-paid runs with the recording wrapper around the actual run_eval_task, per-scenario rows, plus one discarded environment-failure run. No mocks, no fallback scoring, no cached rows.
scope: managed Vertex EvalTask service invocation only; usable managed scores NOT verified

method.pipeline: scripts/run_gcp_eval.py::run_evaluation_pipeline via scripts/gcp_eval_live_gate.py, which wraps (never mocks) GCPVertexAIEvaluationHarness.run_eval_task and records its result
method.coverage: full canonical suite (no --domains filter), 9 domains, 97 SLA measurements, threshold 3.5, allow_fallback=False
method.authentication: Vertex ADC; GCP settings read from the maintainer's env file via dotenv_values; values never printed or committed; a scratch history path was used so the tracked regression ledger was not modified
method.billed: the maintainer's GCP project (value withheld); gemini-3.5-flash-lite judges and EvalTask autorater; two full live runs plus one discarded run that failed before the managed gate
method.gate_definition: managed EvalTask status must be COMPLETED (non-COMPLETED calls aggregator.record_error and forces CI exit 1); CI gate additionally requires summary.all_passed and no regression

spread.method: domain-level overall_mean delta run2 - run1 across the 9 canonical domains, recomputed from committed domain_summaries

superseded.why: earlier live run without per-scenario rows; its figures could not be recomputed from committed rows (AGENTS.md 6.6 / rule 80). Replaced by live_gate_rows_run1.json, not invalidated as a result.
earlier live run without per-scenario rows; same reason. Replaced by live_gate_rows_run2.json.

discarded.cause: First full run reached the managed gate but EvalTask returned FAILED: 'Vertex AI Evaluation Service unavailable: No module named vertexai' (optional google-cloud-aiplatform[evaluation] extra missing from the venv). Environment failure, not a model or gate result.
discarded.fix: Installed google-cloud-aiplatform[evaluation] into the shared venv (no manifest change; uv pip check clean) and re-ran the full pipeline twice, both producing status COMPLETED.

finding: The managed Vertex EvalTask SERVICE was invoked successfully in BOTH live full-suite runs (status=COMPLETED, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, 97 rows each), and all 97 per-scenario rubric records are committed so the CI summary is recomputed from rows rather than duplicated from a saved flag. However the managed autorater produced NO usable scores: summary_metrics mean/std are NaN and every score cell is None, so COMPLETED proves service invocation only, not that managed scoring worked. The full CI gate is also unstable across runs with this configuration: rows-run1 passed (exit 0), rows-run2 failed (exit 1) with a regression on exploit_chain/c2_detection (variance pinned in 'spread'). Therefore TASK-D03 is closed ONLY under the explicitly narrowed acceptance 'managed Vertex EvalTask service invocation verified'; usable managed scores and a stable CI gate remain unverified and are a reopen condition, not a claim of completion. One pre-gate SDK failure is recorded as discarded with its fix; two earlier runs lacking per-scenario rows are recorded as superseded, not deleted.
caveats: Managed autorater scores are unusable (NaN mean/std, None cells); COMPLETED must not be read as a scoring pass.
Judge scores vary per run; rows-run1 passed and rows-run2 regressed on exploit_chain/c2_detection. A single passing run is not a stability guarantee.
No Tier-1 Jev calls are involved in this evidence; it is the System-1 managed EvalTask gate plus per-scenario judges.

The dual-gate 'tool_trajectory_avg_score: 1.0' belongs to System 2 (tests/eval/eval_config.json / report_generator.py) and is not exercised here; this task's blocker was specifically the managed Vertex gate.
Gateway TASK-F04 packaging re-verification remains re-scoped to that task.
